12:Tc03eb,<p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d0187b46-a70f-4edc-ad1b-a5566cd24129" style="">올해 기아 타이거즈의 잇몸 야구를 대표하는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f70c559f-a5d5-46dd-8cb3-673fa491aadf" style="">가장 인상적인 선수를 뽑자면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-05095b78-bf70-4d07-87d3-c761629f0fac" style="">오선우 선수를 거론하지 않을 수 없습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-54722a16-c56b-42f3-83b1-ac0564d220f8" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">기록항목</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">오선우</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">나성범</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">OPS</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.811</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.756</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">wRC+</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">126.3</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">114.0</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">공격 WAR</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">1.38</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.63</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a2952d05-f0cf-49ff-9a97-fe99f20933a7" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-604e1a39-387c-435a-8636-6aeaf7aa528f" style="">주요 공격 지표에서 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-c3d078b4-7abc-499a-bd05-35c595a4be4a" style="">원래 그 자리를 차지해야 했던</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-e030224e-a8bf-4a25-803d-63b310eab5dc" style="">나성범 선수보다 앞서 있다는 사실이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-918714e4-19f2-44b0-b55d-aa78b3d74a41" style="">이것을 입증합니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-407e61fa-79f0-4e3a-8322-fb9c94692d74" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223958948036_0.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-6b6cb486-b5cb-4d42-bbcf-8728afacaa34" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-24c22a83-3e04-499f-9232-cce991d3a4d6" style="">하지만 후반기 들어 나성범 선수가 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d1b095f2-299e-4553-8bb8-dfc839eea58f" style="">부상에서 복귀하여</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-43f68fb6-79a1-4a27-8d91-a5685649284f" style="">슬슬 제 컨디션을 되찾아가고 있는 반면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-00954a21-9585-4b74-9963-2caad6a068a6" style="">대조적으로 오선우는 가장 안 좋은 모습을</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-814458dc-4c0d-47f1-b384-bf1efb7ee9d1" style="">보이고 말았는데요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a4c2ab44-18cd-47f0-8be8-e0bca192eba9" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223958948036_1.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-cbb8ff06-5ff9-47f3-8f80-a11d532ecbc9" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-02cdf7e7-b9d3-4ecd-84f3-3cc579b482d1" style="">공교롭게도 나성범이 지난주 팀 내에서 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f5a68171-3841-4644-910c-3d400897e2bb" style="">가장 높은 OPS를 기록하는 동안</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d3a6318b-c9b1-4c66-b5fa-777d8ea18e0c" style="">오선우는 가장 낮은 OPS를 기록하고 말았습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-d5b0bf0d-9879-4d97-8565-dd93f3bc5761" style="color:#5bc7ff;"><strike>(2위부터는 거기서 거기라는 건 비밀~)</strike></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-53a3f2b2-2fec-4dd2-8682-084b40657116" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223958948036_2.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ad5a7790-6e99-4693-9f16-6bc51273c9a7" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-62f20784-1be5-41e0-bff0-1bd6573c6b6f" style="">그런데 주목할 점은</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-449c72d5-df8a-4f6e-b1b7-9cee7b413dde" style="">오선우 선수의 부진이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-7d44bc92-8256-4490-bbf0-09b7fcb5bacd" style="">지난 1주일에 그쳤던 것이 아니라는 점인데요~</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-58755109-6179-455d-a4b9-ba1f9148b041" style="">사실 오 선수는 후반기 들어서부터 계속 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-7760171c-e925-49ad-9514-0e5fd8bc47e2" style="">좋지 않은 모습을 보이고 있었습니다.</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">기록항목</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">전반기</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">후반기</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">OPS</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.840</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.619</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">타율</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.307</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.167</td></tr></tbody></table><p><img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223958948036_3.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f426d242-70c8-4835-87d1-a87e3fa53790" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0a107db3-6448-4e35-91d8-9b0383192f08" style="">흡사 이 모습만 보면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-fdbf2a9e-943e-451e-a960-4e0d3f2107ad" style="">작년 전반기에 맹활약하다가</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-3885ce75-4f40-45ce-99ec-86cbbc00c3a8" style="">후반기에 성적이 곤두박질친</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-e9325575-82b1-4e1c-92b5-70ea356ee31a" style="">어떤 선수가 떠오르는데요...</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ea2e6b3b-35ff-41f2-b0af-570cfde99ab1" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-ece66d9c-e406-44e8-874a-48c603fd5ca8" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://mobile.newsis.com/view/NISX20240628_0002791677" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="'타율 0.317' KIA 이우성, 허벅지 부상으로 1군 말소…김선빈 복귀"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://mobile.newsis.com/view/NISX20240628_0002791677" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        '타율 0.317' KIA 이우성, 허벅지 부상으로 1군 말소…김선빈 복귀
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        허벅지 힘줄 손상…2주 뒤 재검진 예정 부상서 회복한 김선빈, 16일 만 1군 합류
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-faa2e09e-76bb-4b7d-a8f1-3a3afa358543" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-cc6a6b6c-8ff5-4536-b9f0-62cb4c0541e8" style="">바로 지난주 급작스럽게 발표된</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0a9c8505-209e-497b-abf5-b069f92c059f" style="">트레이드의 주인공 이우성 선수입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-dca65ba2-8e6d-44ed-a568-ffa7e25409e3" style="">작년 후반기부터의 부진이 계속되면서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-45471ed1-edfb-42b0-bbb2-74ce586f288c" style="">결국 NC로 돌아가고 말았는데요...</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-7b81d14e-dc36-4502-ba28-f87fa3adf718" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">기록항목</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">전반기</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">후반기</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">OPS</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.842</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.578</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">타율</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.317</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.223</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-aa7d7256-ca6d-4684-a71b-cf201587d219" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-de2afdd6-cc25-4c15-9c09-df4d37dcfe07" style="">위의 표가 이우성 선수의 작년</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-82e4063e-61dd-4658-804c-448bf4c1b02a" style="">전반기와 후반기 성적 차이입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-94ee7618-58d2-4a81-84d7-ad16b6922346" style="">오선우 선수의 값과 많이 비슷하죠???</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-41466191-6bda-46e6-93ef-8ca1f47559a2" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs11 se-ff-" id="SE-fae36754-bea2-4f50-9e29-d220378f0e15" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://sports.news.nate.com/view/20250606n10378" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="KIA 31세 대기만성 스타의 시련이 계속된다…AVG 0.231, 급기야 2군행 통보, 1년전 부상이 원인일까[MD광주] : 네이트 스포츠"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://sports.news.nate.com/view/20250606n10378" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        KIA 31세 대기만성 스타의 시련이 계속된다…AVG 0.231, 급기야 2군행 통보, 1년전 부상이 원인일까[MD광주] : 네이트 스포츠
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        한눈에 보는 오늘 : 야구 - 뉴스 : 21일 오후 경기도 수원시 조원동 수원kt위즈파크에서 진행된 '2025 프로야구 KBO리그' kt위즈와 KIA타이거즈의 경기. 기아 이우성이 9회초 1사에서 안타를 치고 있다./마이데일리[마이데일리 = 광주 김진성 기자] KIA 타이거즈 외야수 이우성
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-e3d21df5-957f-4627-80b7-bd32b8ff285c" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-35db99e5-6537-4f50-928d-42358abe3df1" style="">그런데 이우성 선수의 부진은</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-05b7eb58-8212-48f7-be8a-23053b3722d3" style="">부상이 원인이었다고 추측이라도</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-46051468-40d9-48b4-8c79-e804f8a85d29" style="">해볼 수 있지만,</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0d088c70-95ed-4610-b6df-9a56a478f4a2" style="">오선우 선수는 부상이 있는것도 아니니</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d228a3d4-4ecd-4bad-9da5-6434fc8f6911" style="">더 답답할 노릇입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ed022e5e-d04f-4fa1-bd83-cd4bce4f8129" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223958948036_4.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a71e9942-f1ed-4097-a2c3-718347e46363" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-de6daf30-db29-449c-ac7c-c1093a4356b7" style="">부진의 원인은 무엇일까요?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-1f2f04e9-6908-4d08-9d25-eae258fb9ebe" style="">기록에서 그 원인을 유추해보기 위해서 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-1ac72065-459c-47e3-aba4-7e40ff0e2173" style="">예전에 오선우 선수에 대한 내용을 남겼던</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-35f00f84-b1b1-42b8-b066-09730b1c8ab2" style="">포스팅을 다시 살펴보겠습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5a72cee3-bdac-4778-9efe-d32a3d93ffd5" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-b2017601-649b-4a06-ad06-7d25f3f2e4fc" style="">

                        지난주 까다로운 상대를 만나서 4승 2패라는 만족스러운 성적을 거둔 기아 타이거즈! 이가 없어서 잇몸으로...

<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-17bd86f9-299f-4fbc-94c3-6c197a4b3b57" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2538a3cf-c923-45c7-9a23-2dc218a12e27" style="">위 글에서 제가 오선우 선수가</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-dc7bf891-6012-4f4b-bd43-6c11c22798a5" style="">올 시즌 잘하게 된 이유를 정리했었는데요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-742524c8-a88e-4134-84ce-47cbcd461487" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-nanummaruburi" id="SE-3f211ed3-3865-46e5-ac3c-30a10ae265a6" style="color:#bb005c;"><b>첫째. 헛스윙률이 줄었다.</b></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-nanummaruburi" id="SE-29b8412b-3599-4080-a45a-5c1c4316eab1" style="color:#bb005c;"><b>둘째. 스트라이크존에 오는 공을</b></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-nanummaruburi" id="SE-f27d45f3-fe51-417f-b7c0-b4e8b878a8d8" style="color:#bb005c;"><b>더 많이 맞추고 있다.</b></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-nanummaruburi" id="SE-c555093f-9372-4f5d-ae73-93be344805b9" style="color:#bb005c;"><b>셋째. 그러나 변화구에 여전히 약하다.</b></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-nanummaruburi" id="SE-6528a7fd-0bda-4424-a75a-cebaabd4d5f5" style="color:#bb005c;"><b>​</b></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-eb9706e5-5239-48fc-b0d7-21f24e24feca" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2acb27bc-37b7-4b2b-a08a-ddb66531cefb" style="">그렇다면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-81c0092a-6b7b-429a-9f5e-58514e62b69b" style="">여전히 헛스윙을 잘 안 하는지?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-6e655d8e-f1df-4bab-91fd-58b08ba72e80" style="">스트라이크존에 오는 공을</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-78100908-6dca-42c1-a54c-5809368aba3b" style="">잘 맞추고 있는지</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-43dc9e2d-592a-487a-baa7-86fb530841a8" style="">변화구에 더 약해지지 않았는지?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9ee7f935-72b5-4a45-a747-d3b304479faf" style="">체크해 보면 되겠죠~</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-125b7d2c-ffa1-45a4-8477-b9c0a35fb658" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">​</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">6월 9일까지</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">시즌 현재까지</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">헛스윙률</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">17.2%</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">17.2%</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">인플레이 타구 비율</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.581</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.571</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">체인지업 타율</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.250</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.263</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-509b8bf2-2ee7-4f73-b602-54abf55bcc31" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-3af6507b-1cdd-4f75-9a35-447d96042e45" style="">보시다시피 위의 세가지 세부지표상에서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-40701e8e-b33f-45fa-b637-84b93c39240c" style="">크게 달라진 점이 없습니다!</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0e05f7cc-8dc4-4510-8293-ec33a6a0aece" style="">이것은 업그레이드 된 모습을 후반기 들어서도</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-1c58b846-bf93-4c43-be5a-19596bab37d5" style="">유지하고 있다는 의미인데요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-c573cdbf-c13f-4552-8b8f-43ff0525bed5" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2eca1adb-cc8c-41f5-a805-1992cb8645f3" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">​</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">전반기</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">후반기</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">BABIP</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.424</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.222</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">전체투구대비볼비율</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">35.1%</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">38.5%</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">타석당 투구 수</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.389</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">4.57</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-fba4b6c7-b552-41cb-a978-44da55083306" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0801fce1-87d5-4b2c-854b-a2f612a0377b" style="">그렇다고 후반기 들어 달라진 게 아예 없느냐?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-573cec02-e3f4-4ac8-ac08-70e37904834d" style="">그렇지는 않습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-6d7729e5-7584-4b0e-9495-45ba6a830e7a" style="">앞서서 확인해보지는 않았던 지표 중에</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-872976a0-ce42-4e67-8e90-fdd54cab5ea4" style="">후반기 들어 달라진 것들도 있는데요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-aa63bac5-329e-4d46-b7b5-5c07d3a80577" style="">일단 BABIP가 엄청 떨어졌습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d95a4579-25dc-42af-b118-86814912487f" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-41b28221-3904-48a5-9422-d6a0b0b3877d" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-139edf3f-cc6a-4d87-9391-16e06312dcce" style="">공을 맞혀서 인플레이 타구를 만들어도</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-580feca1-2614-4e35-873e-9bc50ec52fbd" style="">안타가 잘 안된다는 건데요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-07341f86-3783-45e5-ba07-53841b1a14c5" style="">원래 이 선수는 컨텍이 안되었으면 안 되었지</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-426d4409-3a36-4a6a-9218-bc62a29a475e" style="">일단 맞추면 하드힛이기 때문에</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-44870d7e-824b-4548-ac1d-811db194fa53" style="">BABIP가 높은 유형의 선수라고 했었죠?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-930e1a14-d268-446d-863b-b3f01249da2f" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223958948036_5.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-61fc0590-0695-444e-82bb-a6c1a6668602" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2b07a909-5730-4619-b3b4-563486f3fb9c" style="">그런데 헛스윙을 더 많이 하는 것도 아니고</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2487a044-2b4f-4c19-90b2-15c3d5489caa" style="">인플레이 타구 비율은 그대로이다?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-3d1fc487-e400-4c3a-9cd0-9a7e696ae806" style="">그렇다면 후반기에 지독하게</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9a6c2d4f-a87d-458e-a326-36e22bb66a5e" style="">운이 없다고 밖에 생각할 수 없는데요...</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9e2ae842-72d7-4f6a-bf38-9c3fc9ef7e9c" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0bbeb61e-5d84-47f0-9d6b-56753e782401" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-8d58cead-529f-48f9-ae24-2e89fb1c0492" style="">꼭 그렇다고 보기만은 어려운 게요~</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-e701e056-b9da-46c5-890e-86e2c12daacc" style="">투수들이 오선우 선수를 상대로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0623dea9-3306-4661-a45b-f0c5327173b5" style="">볼을 더 많이 던지고 있다는 점을</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-72b5e76a-c3a8-49d6-8909-ac8c4429cacf" style="">이야기하지 않을 수 없네요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-78bde821-7578-47a2-a86d-7aa4742d4825" style="">이는 정면 승부를 해도 되는 선수에서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f33cd2d5-a2fb-4ce3-8736-1bfd3898c78a" style="">유인구를 더 많이 던져야 하는 선수로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9b01a397-a22b-4816-8e2d-733e750c70e4" style="">전력분석평가가 바뀌었다는 이야기겠죠~</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-3f231784-853c-4141-9c2e-d6313716c038" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223958948036_6.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9eba7171-2bb4-4433-9ab1-0a4daab7dced" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-b7b8c146-d4e0-4bf1-a8dc-24d03581ca3c" style="">그러다 보니 타석당 투구 수가</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-dc7d9d41-dd93-456e-81c5-53dc397b0d9f" style="">상당히 늘어났습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-efefeaa3-61ed-4730-b9b2-093c5d5ea31a" style="">사실 이런 점은 이우성 선수가 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-26a2a52b-9fa2-4035-b473-c455532f7dad" style="">작년 후반기에 보였던 지표와는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d62330d9-9e8f-42bb-8e4d-3442709375df" style="">다른 양상인데요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-02e36740-df61-4334-b7fb-6a5fb6285014" style="">​</span><br/></p>

<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-46c62d05-c292-4b7d-8610-29558c807bb8" style="">부상으로 인한 컨디션 난조가 뚜렷했던</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0f0249db-4642-473a-926d-2dfe7548b14e" style="">이우성 선수에게는 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-36932d84-723e-4c56-b89e-150e35a8b31d" style="">후반기 들어 상대 투수들이 오히려 정면 승부를</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9b35337e-b9a6-47af-9951-2db02fd98f51" style="">했었음을 알 수 있습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-e62c104e-7879-496f-8117-0372e3727646" style="">원인이 다르니 해법도 달라야겠죠?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-eba304e6-f94d-4105-83d5-db9141bf4eb2" style="">해결책을 찾는 건</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-c0606fbb-ea96-4fe4-99cc-4deed59b7f34" style="">기아 타이거즈 코칭스태프의 몫이니</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5ce542e3-496b-43d3-86f0-bc15572c21ce" style="">오선우 선수가 잘 극복해 주기를 바라면서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-36e6dd85-906b-486f-9c40-3871a4f09712" style="">오늘의 포스팅을 마치겠습니다~</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-60549cc8-6d2e-4d19-b02c-b80868047b31" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-545ccba8-7f35-4ae2-8737-38ff11b15c0a" style="">​</span><br/></p>
